title: Austin Approves $3,642 Construction Payment
summary:
• **Emergency meeting called** to approve payment to Brown & Dabney construction company for work completed under a June 1894 contract

• **$3,642.79 appropriation** passed to cover the second estimate bill for construction materials and labor

• **Close vote on adjournment** split the council 8-7, with supporters of quick passage narrowly winning to move the payment forward

• **14 of 22 aldermen present**, with 8 absent from the called meeting held at Austin City Hall
transcript:
Minutes of a Called meeting of the City Council.
Austin, Tex. August 27, 1894.
Hon John McDonald, mayor, presiding.
Roll call.
Present- Aldermen Anderson, Assmann, Glues, Jackson, Lawless, Linn, Nitschke, North,
Raymond, Redd, Roberdeau, Schneider, Shelley, Townsend - 14.
Absent- Aldermen Dawson, Fischer, Hancock, Hume, Platt, Powell, Taylor, Warmoth- 8
The following was read:

Mayor's Office
Austin, Tex. Aug 27, 1894.
To the Members of the Board of Aldermen of the City of Austin, Tex.
Gentlemen- I hereby call a special meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin to
assemble in the council chamber at the city hall on this day, August 27, 1894, at 5
o'clock p m. for the purpose of making an appropriation to pay estimate No 2. in favor of
Brown & Dabney for work done and material furnished under thier contract dated June 14,
1894.
John McDonald, Mayor

Austin, Texas, Aug 27, 1894. 4 p m
I hereby certify that the following aldermen have been served with the above call by
having it read to each of them in person, viz- Anderson, Assmann, Dawson, Glues, Hume,
Jackson, Lawless, Linn, Nitschke, North, Platt, Powell, Raymond, Redd, Roberdeau,
Schneider, Shelley, Taylor, Townsend, and Warmoth and that Aldermen Fischer and Hancock
have been served by an official copy being left at each of their respective places of
business.
James E Lucy, City Marshal.
Alderman Anderson moved a call of the council.
Alderman Linn moved as a substitute that the ordinance referred to in the call of the
council be read and referred to the Finance Committee. Carried.
Alderman Anderson introduced an ordinance appropriating $3642.79 for the purpose of paying
estimate No 2 in favor of Brown & Dabney, under thier contract with the city of Austin,
dated June 14, 1894.
Alderman Linn moved that the council stand adjourned. The motion was adopted by the
following vote: Yeas- Aldermen Assmann, Jackson, Lawless, Linn, Raymond, Roberdeau,
Townsend, Mayor- 8 Nays- Aldermen Anderson, Glues, Nitschke, North, Redd, Schneider,
Shelley, - 7.
Milton Morris,
City Clerk.
